title: Parley — Outcome Record
description: Response body for GET /api/pact/parleys/{id}/outcome (§19.6), also delivered to each Mandate's escalation_hook via §21 on close. Outcomes are advisory unless outcome_binding was `commitment` AND both per-handler §17.6 proofs verified — absent either proof the server records the outcome as advisory and notes the downgrade. Added in PACT v2.1 (§19).

outcome_binding.description: As agreed at open, possibly downgraded per §19.6.

binding_downgraded.description: True when `commitment` was requested but a per-handler proof was absent or failed §17.7 — the outcome is advisory and this flag says why.

converged_content.description: What the agents converged on, if anything (aligned outcomes).

mandate_digest.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the §20.3 canonical Mandate body this side negotiated under.

authorization_proof.description: Per-handler §17.6 proof — REQUIRED for a binding `aligned` outcome (SOQ4).

closed_by.description: Principal or agent that closed early; null on timeout/mandate_revoked.
